# C API

**Package:** CMake target `adxl355::adxl355`

## Capability boundary

Core lifecycle, range, ODR, bounded FIFO count/decode/read, raw/converted reads, temperature, status, signed offsets, calibration helpers, and bounded self-test response.

**Not exposed:** No public interrupt configuration API or maintained Linux bus adapter.

## Authoritative sources

- [`$c/include/adxl355/adxl355.h`](../../c/include/adxl355/adxl355.h)
- [`$c/include/adxl355/adxl355_registers.h`](../../c/include/adxl355/adxl355_registers.h)
- [`$c/include/adxl355/adxl355_version.h`](../../c/include/adxl355/adxl355_version.h)

## Native documentation command

```bash
cmake -S c -B build/c && cmake --build build/c
```
